transcript: Here are six things you can tell yourself to immediately relieve anxiety. First, nothing needs to be solved right now. The anxious mind creates false emergencies. It makes everything feel urgent when most things simply need time. Breathe. Be here. This moment is enough. Second, you are not behind in life. The sun does not rush to rise. A flower does not compete with another flower. Everything blooms in its own timing, and so will you. Third, just because your body feels anxious does not mean you are failing. Feeling anxious does not make you weak. It makes you human. Fourth, not every thought in your mind is true. Fear writes stories that feel real, but thoughts are only visitors. You do not have to believe all of them. Fifth, return to the present moment. Most suffering comes from living too much in the future or too long in the past. Peace can only be found here, in this breath, in this moment. And lastly, remember this carefully. You have survived every difficult season before this one. Every heartbreak, every sleepless night. Yet, here you are, still breathing, still becoming. And if you believe in God, trust that there is a reason for what you cannot yet understand. If your soul has been tired lately, my book, The Way Back to Stillness, is waiting for you in the link in my profile. Comment, Stillness, if you are choosing peace over fear.
